IPL 2027 trades updated: Full list of confirmed player swaps, with new teams and fees on November 11
 Ten players have changed teams ahead of the November 17 retention deadline. Here is the full list with new teams and fees.
 Updated : Nov 11, 2026 10:18 IST - 2 MINS READ

 With the IPL player retention deadline less than a week away, teams are busy making important swaps.
 With the IPL player retention deadline less than a week away, teams are busy making important swaps.
 The IPL 2027 trade window has delivered its biggest swap yet. Hardik Pandya is heading to Punjab Kings, while Arshdeep Singh moves to Mumbai Indians. The two franchises finalised the straight swap on November 11.
 The deal is the fourth completed trade of the cycle, following the Rishabh Pant-Kuldeep Yadav swap between Delhi Capitals and Lucknow Super Giants, the Natarajan-Ansari swap between DC and SRH, and a four-player exchange between CSK and SRH. Ten players have now changed teams.
 ALSO READ
 Hardik Pandya-Arshdeep Singh trade: How Punjab Kings and Mumbai Indians benefit from the IPL blockbuster
 Franchises have until November 17 to submit their retention and release lists, and the mini-auction is scheduled for December 16 in Goa. More deals could still land before the deadline, with Rajasthan Royals and Lucknow Super Giants reportedly in talks.
 Here is every confirmed trade so far, with the new team and fee for each player.
 1. Hardik Pandya 
 Previous team: MI
 New team: PBKS
 New fee: Rs 18 crore
 2. Arshdeep Singh 
 Previous team: PBKS
 New team: MI
 New fee: Rs 18 crore
 3. Rishabh Pant 
 Previous team: LSG
 New team: DC
 New fee: Rs 15 crore
 4. Kuldeep Yadav 
 Previous team: DC
 New team: LSG
 New fee: Rs 13.5 crore
 5. T. Natarajan 
 Previous team: DC
 New team: SRH
 New fee: Rs 5 crore
 6. Zeeshan Ansari 
 Previous team: SRH
 New team: DC
 New fee: Rs 40 lakh
 7. Liam Livingstone 
 Previous team: SRH
 New team: CSK
 New fee: Rs 6 crore
 8. Jack Edwards 
 Previous team: SRH
 New team: CSK
 New fee: Rs 3 crore
 Previous team: CSK
 New team: SRH
 New fee: Rs 4.8 crore
 10. Nathan Ellis 
 Previous team: CSK
 New team: SRH
 New fee: Rs 2 crore
